questions.question:
Select the option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

6, 11, 33, 65, 141, ?
questions.solution:
The given series: 6, 11, 33, 65, 141, ?

It is an alternate series as shown below:

6 × 2 - 1 = 11

11 × 2 + 11 = 33

33 ​× 2 - 1 = 65

65 ​× 2 + 11 = 141

141 ​× 2 - 1 = 281

Hence, **281 **will be the next term in the series.

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 10 pieces of a type of refrigerator, each at Rs.27,000. He sold 5 pieces at 20%, 3 at 10%, and rest at 5% more than the price he bought them at. What was the net profit (in Rs) for the shopkeeper on the whole transaction?
questions.solution:
Cost price of each refrigerator = Rs. 27000

Selling price of the 5 refrigerators sold at 20% profit = 5 × 27000 × 1.2 = Rs. 162000

Selling price of the 3 refrigerators sold at 10% profit = 3 × 27000 × 1.1 = Rs. 89100

Selling price of the 2 refrigerators sold at 5 % profit = 2 × 27000 × 1.05 = Rs. 56700

Total selling price = Rs. 307800

Total cost price = 10 × 27000 = Rs. 270000

Profit = Rs. 307800 - Rs. 270000 = Rs. 37800

Hence, the net profit is **Rs. 37800**.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

3 - 36 × 9 ÷ 3 + 12 = 3
questions.solution:
The given equation: 3 - 36 × 9 ÷ 3 + 12 = 3

**On interchanging × and -,**

we get:

L.H.S = 3× 36 - 9 ÷ 3 + 12 

⇒ 108 - 3 + 12

⇒ 117 ≠ R.H.S

**On interchanging + and ÷,**

we get:

L.H.S = 3 - 36 × 9 + 3 ÷ 12

⇒ 3 - 324 + 0.25

⇒ 320.75 ≠ R.H.S

**On interchanging ÷ and -,**

we get:

L.H.S = 3 ÷ 36 × 9 - 3 + 12 = 3

⇒ 0.75 + 9 

⇒ 9.75 ≠ R.H.S

**On interchanging ÷ and ×,**

we get:

L.H.S. = 3 - 36 ÷ 9 × 3 + 12 

⇒ 3 - 12 + 12

⇒ 3 = 3 (R.H.S.)

Hence, we need to interchange the positions of **÷ and ×** to make the equation correct.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the two numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given number-pair.

14 ∶ 45
questions.solution:
The logic is as:

14 : 45,

14 × 3 + 3 = 45

Similarly,

17 × 3 + 3 = 51 + 3 = 54

Hence, **17 : 54** is similar to 14 : 45
